caption: Review and launch for our draft: $50 a day for the whole US, at most $50 set aside today and about $1,500 a month until paused. Reddit sits out at this budget. Adwave drafted the plan from a website address in about 4 minutes.
Adwave has no subscription; you fund a prepaid wallet. A $50 card top-up adds $1.81 in card fees, so $51.81 at checkout, while a bank top-up has no card fee. We cancelled before paying.
Home about two hours later: the draft waits at Review & launch, and nothing is charged before you launch. The account box is hidden.

All five free starter ads ended in Render failed after more than two hours, while the status screen had said usually under 30 minutes. So you cannot judge an ad before you fund the wallet. The account box is hidden.
